mapper.select: select table_name from information_schema.tables where table_schema = database() and left(table_name, length(#{tablePrefix})) = #{tablePrefix} order by table_name

choose.when: select count(*) from t_following where user_id = #{entityId}
select count(*) from t_following where following_user_id = #{entityId}
select count(*) from t_note_collection where note_id = #{entityId} and status = 1
select count(*) from t_note_collection c join t_note n on n.id = c.note_id where n.creator_id = #{entityId} and c.status = 1
select count(*) from t_note_like l join t_note n on n.id = l.note_id where n.creator_id = #{entityId} and l.status = 1
select count(*) from t_note_like where note_id = #{entityId} and status = 1
select count(*) from t_note where creator_id = #{entityId} and status <> 2
select coalesce((select following_total from t_user_count where user_id = #{entityId}), 0)
select coalesce((select fans_total from t_user_count where user_id = #{entityId}), 0)
select coalesce((select collect_total from t_note_count where note_id = #{entityId}), 0)
select coalesce((select collect_total from t_user_count where user_id = #{entityId}), 0)
select coalesce((select like_total from t_user_count where user_id = #{entityId}), 0)
select coalesce((select like_total from t_note_count where note_id = #{entityId}), 0)
select coalesce((select note_total from t_user_count where user_id = #{entityId}), 0)
insert ignore into t_note_count (note_id) values (#{entityId})
select note_id from t_note_count where note_id = #{entityId} for update
choose.otherwise: select user_id from t_user_count where user_id = #{entityId} for update

choose.when: update t_user_count set following_total = #{total} where user_id = #{entityId}
update t_user_count set fans_total = #{total} where user_id = #{entityId}
update t_note_count set collect_total = #{total} where note_id = #{entityId}
update t_user_count set collect_total = #{total} where user_id = #{entityId}

update t_note_count set like_total = #{total} where note_id = #{entityId}
